answer: Hold a simultaneous roll-call: every identity must appear at the same 10-minute ceremony each week, signing with a key. One person can attend only one grove of the atlas at once, so a farmer running 1,000 puppets can staff at most a handful. Miss 2 ceremonies in a row and the identity freezes; a second miss within 30 days burns a $25 deposit. A canyon of empty seats exposes the farm: 1,000 fakes cost $25,000 in forfeits.
